title: Olea M2 sanitized acceptance attempt
description: Original MIT. Artifact bytes and producer assertions must be independently reviewed; schema validity is not workflow success.

caseId.description: Must match immutable expected catalog ID.

summary.description: Manually sanitized result. Never raw stdout/provider/headers/config.

execution.description: Retain domain Activity/service/run-as, real Android UID, compile/min/target SDK, Android/API/ABI, actual allocation, boot identity, PID/start ticks/UID, bridge state, rootfs/package/artifact identities. Never process environment or credential-bearing cmdline.

provider.description: allocationId, model, topLevelPrompts, observed HTTP/model/tool rounds separately, observed usage and unknown billing; no secrets or raw request/response.

provenance.description: Source URL, exact version/commit, SHA256, license/notice paths, original MIT versus third-party obligations; no unsupported signature/license clearance claim.

currentState.description: Exact observed process/device/bridge/phone state, observation timestamp and unknown persisted-state boundaries.
